title: Olu sitere n'Osisi Na-ere Ọkụ
intro: Kọwaa njirimara nke onye dị omimi nke njem ya malitere site n'ọrụ ebube, onye ọdịnihu ya jikọtara ya na ntọhapụ nke ndị a na-emegbu. A họpụtara onye a maka ọrụ dị oke mkpa, na-eche nnukwu ihe ịma aka ihu site na nkwado Chineke.
clues: A mụrụ m n'oge oke mmegbu, ebe a na-egbu ụmụ ọhụrụ nke ndị m.
Ndụ m mgbe m bụ nwata gụnyere ịbụ onye nne na nna m tinyere n'osimiri, mana a hụrụ m ma zụlite m n'ezinụlọ onye na-emegbu ndị m.
E nwere mgbe m si n'obodo gbapụ mgbe m mechara gbuo mmadụ n'amaghị ama n'oge esemokwu.
Anatara m ozi Chineke na mkpara ọrụ ebube n'ebe dị nsọ, ebe e nyere m iwu ka m gaa hụ onye ọchịchị dị ike.
A họpụtara nwanne m nwoke ka ọ bụrụ onye enyemaka nye m n'ọrụ m, n'ihi ihe mgbochi m chere na ọ bụ okwu m.
Eduru m ndị m gafee oké osimiri kewara ekewa, gbanahụ ịchụ ndị agha aka ike.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Afọ oké ọkọchị na-adịgide ruo ọtụtụ afọ
Izute Fero na ndị dibịa afa ya
trial.answer: Izute Fero na ndị dibịa afa ya

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Oké idei mmiri ahụ rikpuru ala ahụ
E rikpuru Fero na ndị agha ya
Mgbidi obodo ahụ dara site na mkpu ákwá
outcome.answer: E rikpuru Fero na ndị agha ya

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
